title: docusystem.config.json
description: The facts about a project that its Avunu documentation site needs. The seven identity keys are required; `docusystem init` infers and writes them.

name.description: Display name: header, page titles, footer.

tagline.description: One sentence on the landing page and the default page description.

slug.description: The project's key in https://avunu.net/projects.json (underscores allowed): it marks the current project in the switcher.

platform.description: Groups the project in the switcher and sets the landing eyebrow.

repo.description: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>: the header link, Edit this page, rewritten repository links.

domain.description: The custom domain, without a scheme. Normally the repository name with hyphens, then .avunu.net.

branch.description: Override of the default branch used in Edit this page and GitHub links. Normally absent: $DOCUSYSTEM_BRANCH (set by the workflow), then origin/HEAD, then main.

docs.description: The folder of Markdown, relative to this file.

theme.description: Design-token overrides, by custom-property name. Names must exist in the installed version; `docusystem check` re-runs the WCAG contrast check on the result.

images.description: `off` skips raster-image optimisation (and so the native sharp module).

jx.description: Unsupported escape hatch, outside semver: a fragment merged into the generated Jx project.json. Objects merge, null deletes a key, `$head` arrays are appended to the package's, other arrays replace (with a warning).
